about: The world/ folder's format. tools/worldgen writes it (stamping world.json with this version) and src/systems/terrain/world_data.gd reads it; both check against this file, so change it here first and bump the version when the format changes.

files.height_hi.bin: zlib: high bytes of the 16-bit heights, texels x texels, then each mip down to 1 x 1
files.height_lo.bin: zlib: low bytes, laid out as height_hi.bin
files.ground.png: RGBA masks: rock, sand, forest density, ambient occlusion
files.trees.bin: zlib: 8 bytes per tree: uint16 x, uint16 z (over the world), uint16 ground height (encoded as the heights), uint8 height (dm), uint8 spare

fields.world_size: float: m, the world's side, centred on the origin
fields.texels: int: height samples per side (sample i at -world_size/2 + i * world_size / texels)
fields.h_min: float: m, the height of 16-bit value 0
fields.h_max: float: m, the height of 16-bit value 65535
fields.boat: [x, z]: where the boat is moored
fields.trees: int: how many trees trees.bin holds
fields.islands: list of river islands {x, z, dx, dz, length, width, top}
fields.rivers: list, downstream order, of {points: [[x, water level, z], ...], half_width: [m per point], depth: [m per point], riser: [per point: 0 at a fall's lip .. 1 at its foot, -1 off them], falls: [[first, last], ...], joins: index of the river it runs into or -1 for the sea}
